title: Service health
intro: DHCP, DNS, the LAN cache, game servers and the internet uplink at a glance. Each service comes from a health plugin; Discord gets a message when one turns red.
noPlugins: No health plugin is on yet. Turn one on under Settings > Plugins (HTTP check, or one for your DHCP, DNS or cache) to fill the wall.
noChecks: The health plugins have nothing to report yet. Check their settings under Settings > Plugins.
